name: resilience
description: Runtime quality in one plugin — does it stay up, can you see it, is it fast. Failure-mode design for integration points (timeouts, retries with backoff, circuit breaking, graceful degradation) with the error-handling and concurrency disciplines and the event-driven skill (brokers, outbox, sagas, DLQ); application observability (structured logs with correlation IDs, RED/USE metrics, trace propagation, honest health checks); measure-first performance (N+1, payload, bundle, Core Web Vitals, cache correctness). One audit, /resilience:review, over all six rubrics or one via --concern, and two workers, observability-engineer and performance-engineer, that apply only what a finding proves.
